Lend Friend

Separating ownership from borrowing status.

Lend Friend explores how people could lend and borrow items within friends, family and community networks.

ProjectLend Friend
Contribution / source recordProject-specific role and delivered scope to confirm.

Design approach

  • Object-oriented UX work maps the relationships between people, items, notes and time.
  • Inventory views distinguish owned items, friends’ items, lent items and borrowed items.
  • Availability, person and due-date information sit alongside the item where lending decisions occur.

Why this work matters

The material shows product structure translating into interface clarity: who owns an item is different from who currently has it.

Reference notes

Original object-model, requirements and inventory artifacts reviewed. Confirm whether this was client, personal or educational work, Sindy’s contribution and what was delivered.
